fixes.summary: _screen_review_structured_decision() (added after PATCH_629) stored float(raw) directly without calling _round_half_up(), silently regressing PATCH_629's rounding fix for the RC/2x6 exterior-wall split answer (the single-value approved_quantity path was unaffected, since it goes through a different function).

new_self_checks.summary: Source-level check that _screen_review_structured_decision() still calls _round_half_up(), plus a behavioral check of _round_half_up()'s known edge cases (2.005->2.01, 0.125->0.13). Verified to fail against the pre-fix code and pass against the fixed code.

verification.regression_of_regression_test_itself: Manually reverted the fix in a scratch copy and confirmed the new self-check fails as expected, then re-confirmed it passes on the fixed source.

process_lesson: When fixing a bug, grep for sibling/duplicate code paths handling the same kind of data before considering the fix complete, and add one dev_checks self-check per fix so future patches cannot silently reintroduce it without being caught automatically.
